### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/ianmaciel7/notes-app/blob/45acd9588c8ba9fbdcc55836bd25462b5c433777/src/components/app-sidebar-primary-actions.tsx#L127-L132 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Wire new-content choices to the action callback** When a consumer supplies `onAction` and selects any entry from the new-content popover, nothing happens: these buttons have no click handler, and the new early return in `AppSidebarPrimaryActionItem` bypasses the former `onAction("new")` path entirely. Pass the callback or a content-selection callback into `NewContentMenu`, invoke it from each choice, and close the popover so the primary New action remains functional. [.agents/rules/shadcn-first.mdL26-L26](https://github.com/ianmaciel7/notes-app/blob/45acd9588c8ba9fbdcc55836bd25462b5c433777/.agents/rules/shadcn-first.md#L26-L26) --- https://github.com/ianmaciel7/notes-app/blob/45acd9588c8ba9fbdcc55836bd25462b5c433777/src/components/app-sidebar-overview.tsx#L597-L600 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Keep section actions visible on touch viewports** On touch-only narrow viewports, the pinned picker remains `opacity-0` because its only reveal condition is `group-hover`; `AppSidebarSectionAction` applies the same hover-only treatment to object-type creation. These core controls are therefore invisible without a hover-capable pointer, contrary to the new mobile-reachability requirement, so add a mobile-visible state and touch-friendly sizing. [.agents/rules/shadcn-first.mdL58-L58](https://github.com/ianmaciel7/notes-app/blob/45acd9588c8ba9fbdcc55836bd25462b5c433777/.agents/rules/shadcn-first.md#L58-L58) --- https://github.com/ianmaciel7/notes-app/blob/45acd9588c8ba9fbdcc55836bd25462b5c433777/src/components/app-sidebar-primary-actions.tsx#L142-L145 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Implement the advertised keyboard navigation** When a keyboard user follows these displayed hints while focus is in the search input, Arrow Up/Down only move the input caret and Enter performs no selection because the popover has no key handler, active-item state, or roving-focus/listbox primitive. Implement the stated navigation and selection behavior, or remove the misleading shortcuts. [.agents/rules/shadcn-first.mdL24-L24](https://github.com/ianmaciel7/notes-app/blob/45acd9588c8ba9fbdcc55836bd25462b5c433777/.agents/rules/shadcn-first.md#L24-L24) --- https://github.com/ianmaciel7/notes-app/blob/45acd9588c8ba9fbdcc55836bd25462b5c433777/openspec/changes/refine-app-sidebar-overview/tasks.md#L10-L11 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Restore the specified context-menu behavior** These tasks are marked complete, but `AppSidebarPinnedMenu` still exposes only open/unpin actions and `AppSidebarObjectTypeMenu` omits template, query, collection, pin, and import actions while rendering `Open` unconditionally without receiving the active state. Users therefore cannot access most newly specified menu flows, and the active destination still shows the action that task 2.2 says must be conditional. --- https://github.com/ianmaciel7/notes-app/blob/45acd9588c8ba9fbdcc55836bd25462b5c433777/openspec/changes/refine-app-sidebar-overview/tasks.md#L6 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Add management controls to custom sections** After creating a custom section, the rendered `AppSidebarSection` receives only its label and open-state callback and contains no rename, sort-mode, or delete control. Consequently none of the three management operations checked off here are reachable; implement and wire those callbacks before treating this task as complete.

data.body: ### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/ianmaciel7/notes-app/blob/49e20cd3f6c1759f7728f69550d456a85d52f129/src/components/block-editor.tsx#L106 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Preserve a visible keyboard focus indicator** Removing the `focus-visible` outline leaves the editable contenteditable with `outline-none` and no replacement focus styling, so keyboard users cannot see when the editor owns focus. This also contradicts the unchanged browser assertion in `tests/e2e/block-editor-interactions.spec.ts:784-797`, which requires a 2px non-`none` outline. Keep a borderless appearance if needed, but provide an equivalent visible focus indicator. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L21-L21](https://github.com/ianmaciel7/notes-app/blob/49e20cd3f6c1759f7728f69550d456a85d52f129/AGENTS.md#L21-L21) --- https://github.com/ianmaciel7/notes-app/blob/49e20cd3f6c1759f7728f69550d456a85d52f129/src/components/workspace-object-page-view.tsx#L2295-L2299 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Reveal existing timestamp properties instead of duplicating them** When a user selects **Created at** or **Last updated** from the new custom-object Add property menu, this path assigns a random ID and marks the definition non-writable. These catalog choices need to reveal the existing system-backed projections rather than append new definitions.
